# Lucide navigation icon source

`lucide-nav.svg` is a mechanical SVG symbol sprite assembled from the following official source files. Geometry and the official presentation attributes (`viewBox`, `fill`, `stroke`, width, line cap, and line join) are unchanged; only the outer `<svg>` wrappers were converted to `<symbol>` elements so the same-origin asset can be reused without a framework or CDN.
